inputs.candidate_selector: $88 indexes $00C6 to select an actor context
inputs.target_axis: $002A,y; Y is supplied by each caller
inputs.direction_bit: bit 0 of $6E selects one of two mirrored comparisons

branches.bound_choice: selects the greater of candidate axis and $12F2; replaces it with $042A when that selected value is below $042A
branches.comparison: adds margin, compares with target axis, returns carry set only when the adjusted value is below target

branches.bound_choice: selects the lesser of candidate axis and $12F2; replaces it with $042A when that selected value is above $042A
branches.comparison: subtracts margin, compares with target axis, returns carry set unless the adjusted value is below target

caller_contract.gate: CODE_80:D5DF bypasses this predicate when CurrentOffSideSetting is non-zero; its caller must provide Y
caller_contract.observable_result: carry is the only stable result exported by CODE_80:D627; D5DF branches on it before writing $00C4

limitations: The semantic identity of $002A, $12F2, $042A, $88, and the caller-provided Y actor is not asserted by this extraction.
Carry is a directional boundary result, not by itself proof of an offside infraction or its restart.
The browser implementation must wait for runtime correlation before using this predicate as final rule logic.
